query:
SELECT 
  ci.id,
  ci.cardName AS inventory_name,
  ci.linkedCardId,
  c.name AS linked_card_name,
  CASE WHEN ci.imageUrl IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'HAS_IMAGE' END AS ci_has_image
FROM cardInventory ci
LEFT JOIN cards c ON ci.linkedCardId = c.id
WHERE ci.linkedCardId IS NOT NULL
  AND c.id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.name != ci.cardName
ORDER BY ci.buyDate DESC
LIMIT 15;
